ℒSFT(θ) = −∑t ∈ Response log πθ(yt | xprompt, y<t)
Figure 7.1: (a) Supervised Instruction Fine-Tuning (SFT) with prompt loss masking and (b) Direct Preference Optimization (DPO; Rafailov et al., 2023).
